full_judgment: 38. The investigation in the case has got a checkered career. On 12-12-1983 Joynab Begum lodged a first information report over the murder of Firoja Begum alleging that her father and brothers might have murdered her and injured her husband, Abdur Rouf. On receipt of the first information report, PW 1 Humayun Kabir as the officer in charge of the station registered a case being Shwarankhola PS case No.9 dated 12-12-1983. The OC himself took up the investigation. He found the dead body of Firoja Begum on the south bank of the canal, held inquest over the body and sent the dead body to morgue for post mortem. After completion of investigation, the Police found the allegations against the father and brothers of the deceased Firoja Begum not proved and accordingly, on 8-5-1984 submitted a final report requesting discharge of the accused named in the first information report. On the same date said Humayun Kabir suo motu lodged a first information report against Abdur Rouf  for commission of murder and Joynab Begum for concealing the evidence, which was registered as Shwarankhola PS case No. 2 dated 8-5-1984. Upon such first information report, on 26-7-1984 PW 15 SI Abdul Wahed submitted a charge-sheet against them. It further appears that the charge-sheet was filed in a form different from that which was captioned 'the final report under section 173 of the Code of Criminal Procedure'. The form in which the charge-sheet was filed does not appear to contain any provision of law. We unsuccessfully looked for the Criminal Rules and Order. We were told, the Rules are not available. Non availability of the Rules indicates another limitation in the administration of criminal justice delivery system in the country. However, it may be mentioned here that in the suo motu first information report, so-called final report and charge sheet, same facts and circumstances were mentioned.
